item.title: Ukraine, Russia accuse each other of violating Orthodox Easter ceasefire
item.summary: Russia and Ukraine accused each other on Sunday of breaching the 32-hour ceasefire in their four-year war, each reporting close to 2,000 drone and shelling attacks just hours after the truce began on Saturday to mark Orthodox Easter.

item.title: Study finds hidden lake network beneath Arctic glaciers as climate change accelerates
item.summary: Researchers have uncovered the locations of 37 subglacial lakes in Canada’s Arctic, 35 of them discovered for the very first time — what could be a major scientific breakthrough in understanding the quickly-warming region.

item.title: U.S. allows nearly 4,500 South African refugees since October — and only 3 from elsewhere
item.summary: President Donald Trump has made good on a promise to drastically cut the number of refugees into the U.S., with white South Africans being the top priority over those fleeing conflict, poverty and other threats to their safety from different countries.

item.summary: The Vatican and the Pentagon have pushed back on a report that suggested a meeting in January between a U.S.-based cardinal and a member of Donald Trump's administration grew heated.

item.title: After 16 years in power, Hungary's Orbán concedes 'painful' election loss to rival Magyar
item.summary: Hungarian Prime Minister Viktor Orbán conceded defeat in Sunday's Hungarian election, ending his 16 years in power.
